title: Step 2b — Incremental log shipping to the standby
goal: Incremental log shipping to the standby.
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
acceptance: Active main appends ordered (coordinatorEpoch, seq) batches with prevDigest and batchDigest
Signed POST /kaji/replicate applies batches to coordinator-standby.sqlite, preserving deliveries.rowid and updating FTS5
Sequence gaps or prevDigest mismatches fail with 409 need_resync (expectedSeq) without mutating standby; stale epoch, non-main sender, or expired lease rejected
validation: Directed regressions or recorded evidence for this slice; final required CI
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-14 from 0.25 h to 0.75 h: feature implementation steps closed since 2026-11-13 took 0.75–1 h (F-066-T01, F-066-T02, F-062-T03, F-044-T01) where the 0.25x pass had set 0.25–1 h; started from this step's estimate, not a ratio.
